description: This Java source file defines the InMemoryDictionary class, which extends BTreeDictionary and manages an in-memory collection of words with associated frequencies. It provides methods for reading words, but throws exceptions for adding or deleting words, indicating in-memory storage is read-only or managed externally.

classes.name: InMemoryDictionary
classes.description: A dictionary implementation that stores words in memory using an ArrayList of Pairs, extending BTreeDictionary, with read-only operations for adding and deleting words.

methods.name: InMemoryDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the in-memory word list with provided words.

methods.name: readWordsFromActualStorage
methods.description: Iterates over stored words and notifies the listener for each word read.

methods.name: deleteWordFromStorage
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, indicating deletion is not supported.

methods.name: addWordToStorage
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, indicating addition is not supported.

methods.name: closeStorage
methods.description: Clears the in-memory list of words.
